payload.report: The painful penile swelling and ulceration, refractory to antibiotics and antifungals, is caused by systemic B-cell lymphoma involving the penis. Penile biopsy shows a clonal CD20+, CD79a+, CD5+ B-cell infiltrate with IgH rearrangement, refuting primary penile malignancy and infectious ulcer. PET-CT reveals FDG-avid abdominal and peripancreatic nodes, confirming systemic disease. Chronic lymphadenopathy, elevated WBC, and B symptoms support hematologic malignancy, establishing the diagnosis.
